news.title: Former Labour candidate Joe Emmett joins Green Party

summary: Emmett Green is reinventing Energy Transition, founded in 2018. Type: startup / scale-up. About 27 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Delft energy-transition start-up developing battery and hydrogen projects and advising industry; small, Dutch-speaking teams with paid internships.

culture.text: About 27 on LinkedIn, while its website says 60 colleagues in engineering, finance, project management and energy-management software.
Staff describe small multidisciplinary teams, a young fast-growing company, freedom, and colleagues who make time to help.
Many studied at TU Delft, University of Twente, Erasmus School of Economics and Nyenrode, mostly in engineering and economics.
Its website and team stories are in Dutch, so the work language is likely Dutch.

open.text: IND recognised visa sponsor (Emmett Green B.V. and Emmett Green Engineering B.V.).
All 3 current jobs here are consulting internships in Delft, Amsterdam and Utrecht that don't require Dutch; 2 of 3 show pay.
A developer on the site says he joined to finish his Mechanical Engineering master's thesis.

growth.text: Founded in 2018, it now says it works with 60 colleagues and builds its own Energy Management System to run energy assets.
